records.title: Lyra Valkyria title match announced
records.summary: WWE officially announced that Lyra Valkyria will defend the Women's Intercontinental Championship against Jordan Star next Saturday in Chicago following their confrontation during Monday Night Raw.

records.title: WWE confirms Lyra title match
records.summary: The company confirmed Lyra Valkyria versus Jordan Star for the Women's Intercontinental Championship next Saturday in Chicago after their confrontation during Monday Night Raw.

records.title: AEW announces tournament bracket
records.summary: AEW announced a separate eight wrestler tournament bracket for Dynamite next month, with four first round matches and a final scheduled for the pay per view.
